hero.headline: Style. Story. Soul.
hero.subheadline: Haanta is where Africa meets the world. Discover designers from Lagos to Accra, hand-picked for quality and shipped to your door in the US and Canada.

pillars.title: Quality Assurance
pillars.body: Every brand is vetted and every piece checked at our Houston hub before it reaches you.

pillars.title: Culture and Heritage
pillars.body: Adire, aso-oke, kente and Ankara, told by the people who make them.

pillars.title: Empowerment
pillars.body: Designers keep their prices; we handle shipping, duties and customer care.

pillars.title: Community
pillars.body: A home for the diaspora and everyone who loves African design.

brandSpotlights.name: Adire Atelier
brandSpotlights.story: Resist-dyed by hand in small batches, each Adire piece carries patterns passed down through generations of Yoruba women.

brandSpotlights.name: Lekki Loom
brandSpotlights.story: Woven on traditional looms and cut into easy, modern shapes: shirts and jackets you will reach for again and again.
